topic: A video call with a foreign team
passage: Last Thursday, my team held its first video call with a foreign team. Although we had prepared the slides for two days, I still felt nervous before the meeting started. At nine in the morning, I logged in early and turned on my camera. My manager introduced everyone, and the foreign team leader filled me in on their plan for the new project. She explained that they had worked on the system for six months and that they needed our help with testing. During the call, the sound cut out twice, and I picked up only half of her words. I asked her to repeat the key points slowly, and she typed them in the chat box. After the meeting, my colleague walked me through the notes and helped me fill in the missing parts. We wrapped up the action list together and sent it to both teams before lunch. In the afternoon, I practiced the new words aloud and wrote down three sentences I want to use next time. It was a hard meeting, but it showed me that I can follow real English at work if I prepare well.

My manager introduced everyone at the start of the meeting.
I want to practice English more before the next meeting.

coach_rationale: 今天继续盯两条老弱项：过去式 -ed 结尾听辨，以及 EnglishPod365 第 7 周笔记里最突出的连读动词短语——passage 里埋了 filled me in、picked up、walked me through、wrapped up、cut out 五组连读靶子，-ed 在清辅音后读 /t/、浊辅音后读 /d/，连读时别把尾音丢了。话题换成没练过的跨国团队视频会，贴他海外远程目标：真实工作场景的英语，才是这套 drill 最终要服务的场合。

vocab.note: 连读靶子：fill + me + in 连成一串，in 不要丢
-ed 在清音 k 后读 /t/，picked up 连读时 t 很轻，容易听漏
walked 的 /t/ 尾音 + through 连读，听写时别写成 walk
wrapped 读 /ræpt/，意思是结束、收尾
声音中断、断线；cut 是不规则过去式，原形过去式同形
